findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_outliers, search_profiles, get_post, get_profile, crawl_profile, download_post_media, report_issue, track_profile, untrack_profile, get_tracked_updates, get_trending_outliers · Private data: search_outliers, search_profiles, download_post_media, track_profile, untrack_profile, get_trending_outliers, get_pricing · Public sink: search_outliers, get_post, request_transcript, request_visual_analysis, resolve_post_url, download_post_media, remix_post, report_issue, track_profile, get_tracked_updates · Destructive: search_outliers, remix_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_outliers, search_profiles, get_post, get_profile, crawl_profile, download_post_media, report_issue, track_profile, untrack_profile, get_tracked_updates, get_trending_outliers · Private data: search_outliers, search_profiles, download_post_media, track_profile, untrack_profile, get_trending_outliers, get_pricing · Public sink: search_outliers, get_post, request_transcript, request_visual_analysis, resolve_post_url, download_post_media, remix_post, report_issue, track_profile, get_tracked_updates · Destructive: search_outliers, remix_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
